Rule_Name: High value cash deposits in a day
Threshold_Logic: Aggregate cash deposits to one account in a day

Rule_Name: High value cash withdrawals in a day
Threshold_Logic: Aggregate cash withdrawals from one account in a day
Notes: Included for completeness but not triggered in this demo

Rule_Name: High value non-cash deposits in a day
Threshold_Logic: Aggregate non-cash credits to one account in a day
Notes: Can support RTGS or NEFT concentration cases

Rule_Name: High value non-cash withdrawals in a day
Threshold_Logic: Aggregate non-cash debits from one account in a day

Rule_Name: Sudden high value transaction for the client
Threshold_Logic: Transaction above absolute floor and above prior largest transaction
Configured_Value: Greater than INR 1500000 and greater than 200 percent of prior largest

Rule_Name: Sudden increase in value of transactions in a month
Threshold_Logic: Current month transaction value exceeds prior average
Configured_Value: Greater than 250 percent of prior 3-month average
Notes: Triggered by AC2001 and AC1003 in Sep 2022

Rule_Name: Sudden increase in number of transactions in a month
Threshold_Logic: Current month transaction count exceeds prior average
Configured_Value: Greater than 200 percent of prior 3-month average
Notes: Triggered by AC2001 and AC1003 in Sep 2022

Rule_Name: Splitting of cash deposits just below INR 1000000
Configured_Value: 3 or more deposits between INR 900000 and INR 999999

Rule_Name: Splitting of cash deposits just below INR 50000
Configured_Value: 3 or more deposits between INR 45000 and INR 49999

Rule_Name: Repeated small value transfers from multiple parties followed by immediate withdrawals
Configured_Value: 2 or more inward transfers below INR 100000 and withdrawal within 24 hours
4 or more unique remitters to one beneficiary
4 or more unique beneficiaries from one sender

Rule_Name: Sudden activity in a dormant account
Configured_Value: No customer-initiated transaction for 90 days then fresh activity

Rule_Name: High value transfer to crypto exchange after suspicious inflow
Threshold_Logic: Customer receives material inflow and transfers funds to a crypto exchange wallet
Configured_Value: Transfer above INR 500000 to a crypto exchange within 24 hours of high-risk inward credit
Notes: Triggered by AC1011 after receipt from ENT001
